consensus_strengths: The paper defines an unusually explicit phase-aware, fail-closed contract that separates mandatory evidence coverage from replay verdicts.

The threat model and trusted computing base are candidly bounded; the manuscript consistently presents its conclusions as conditional, trace-relative evidence rather than security attestation or comprehensive runtime correctness.
The pointer-free storage witnesses, lifecycle receipts, ownership factorial, semantic relations, and matched fault controls form a technically coherent integrated audit methodology.
The primary evaluation demonstrates that semantic equality alone can coexist with decision-relevant persistent-state aliasing, including in a reproduced historical defect.

The source-distinct expected-slot census, out-of-process observation, exact repeat execution, captured-boundary numerical checks, and bounded Falcon comparison provide useful triangulation within their declared scopes.
Memory denominators and cohort authorizations are carefully separated, avoiding conflation of allocator, retained-payload, performance, capacity, and quality claims.
The manuscript is visually sound and extensively documented, with no reviewer reporting a material rendering defect.
consensus_weaknesses: The central ownership conclusion still trusts slot-ID-to-live-tensor binding, honest paused capture, and framework/IPC storage semantics; repetition and census closure do not independently validate this binding boundary.
Dispatch provenance is formally one of seven targets but remains incomplete because the selected compiled binary and autotuning decision are not bound per call.
The evidence is confined largely to constructed faults and fixed schedules, with only one retrospective natural defect and limited production-like concurrency or lifecycle pressure.
No capture-time, replay-time, trace-volume, memory-perturbation, or minimal-profile cost measurement is reported for the proposed offline-CI workflow.
The main narrative is overloaded by auxiliary cohorts, repeated qualifications, serving context, policy panels, and artifact detail, obscuring the minimum decisive evidence.
The eight-item Store-F1 panel is too small to support a robust quality-preservation inference and is too prominent relative to its evidentiary weight.

material_disagreements.topic: Highest-priority significance experiment beyond binding and dispatch closure
positions: Reviewer A prioritizes one native serving-style evaluation with dynamic interleaving, reuse or eviction, and an in-flight ownership transition.
Reviewer B prioritizes comparison against a realistic conventional invariant and lifecycle-check baseline to establish the framework's incremental detection and localization value.
Reviewer C prioritizes a prospective outcome-blind natural-regression set or broader independently generated mutation suite, ideally combined with a more realistic scheduler.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Use one compact, preregistered evaluation that runs clean and independently supplied fault cases under a representative scheduler and scores both ForkAudit and a defined conventional baseline. This jointly addresses schedule realism, unseen-case sensitivity, false positives, unique catches, and localization without requiring three separate studies.

material_disagreements.topic: Whether artifact replay is a current paper defect
positions: Reviewer A flags clean-environment supplement replay as a medium-confidence reproducibility concern because the PDF alone cannot establish package availability or executability.
Reviewers B and C treat non-execution of artifacts as a review limitation and do not allege an artifact defect.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Do not count package incompleteness as an established weakness from this frozen evidence. Require an accessible anonymous supplement and clean replay as an acceptance or artifact-evaluation condition, not as evidence that the reported package is presently defective.

unsupported_reviewer_claims.reason: The review correctly notes that package completeness, executable replay, and recent citations cannot be verified from the PDF, but the frozen objects provide no affirmative evidence that the supplement or citations are incomplete or incorrect. This is an access limitation, not a supported defect allegation.

prioritized_actions.description: Add a mechanism-distinct live-tensor binding witness for principal ownership coordinates and challenge it with correct-shape wrong-object, stale-handle, coherent slot-swap, and role-relabel faults.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: The independent path accepts clean captures and rejects every seeded binding error while explicitly enumerating any binding assumptions that remain trusted.

prioritized_actions.description: Bind the selected compiled artifact and relevant autotuning configuration to every audited call, with fallback and alternate-variant controls; if this cannot be implemented, redefine the completed target as Python-call provenance and move compiled dispatch to an explicit open extension.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Every primary call resolves to one package-bound compiled configuration, and omission, substitution, fallback, or alternate tuning makes coverage incomplete or triggers the dispatch gate; alternatively, all headline seven-target language is narrowed consistently.

prioritized_actions.description: Freeze ForkAudit and a realistic conventional baseline, then evaluate both on clean and independently supplied ownership or lifecycle faults under one representative ragged or continuous-batching schedule that includes reuse or reclamation and an in-flight transition.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Report per-case detections, misses, false positives, unique catches, localization quality, mandatory-slot coverage, and repeated clean outcomes without interpreting the cases as a population estimate.

prioritized_actions.description: Define a minimal contract profile and an extended profile, then measure capture wall time, replay time, artifact size, peak memory perturbation, and implementation burden against an uninstrumented reference.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: A reproducible table reports clearly defined denominators for uninstrumented, minimal, and full profiles and identifies a credible routine-CI cadence.

prioritized_actions.description: Center the main narrative on the contract, primary factorial, historical alias, independent census, bounded transfer, TCB, and unresolved dispatch target; move secondary serving, policy, operator-transfer, and ledger detail to clearly subordinate appendices and add one end-to-end worked example.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: The abstract, introduction, worked example, and one summary table suffice to identify the claim, decisive evidence, trusted boundary, and every incomplete target without consulting auxiliary panels.

prioritized_actions.description: Remove the eight-item Store-F1 result from headline support and label it an illustrative engineering measurement unless a substantially larger frozen disjoint evaluation with paired uncertainty is added.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: The abstract and contribution list no longer imply robust quality preservation from eight items, and the panel states its sample size and bounded inferential status prominently.

prioritized_actions.description: Provide an anonymous, checksum-bound supplement with dependency locks, expected outputs, a CPU replay path where feasible, and a clean-environment transcript reproducing headline aggregates and coverage decisions.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: An independent clean environment reproduces the primary aggregate, target-coverage table, fault decisions, census aggregate, and Falcon aggregate using only submitted materials, while H20-only recapture steps are clearly distinguished.

must_resolve_before_accept: Either complete per-call compiled dispatch and autotuning provenance or consistently narrow the formal contract and headline claim so the unimplemented portion is not presented as a completed core obligation.

Substantially reduce the core ownership assurance gap at the slot-ID-to-live-tensor binding boundary through an independent witness, or narrow the acceptance-level claim to make this dependence unmistakably central rather than a buried TCB caveat.
Provide credible evidence of incremental practical value beyond output-only or weak baselines, preferably through the combined blind fault, strong-baseline, and representative-scheduler evaluation.
Ensure the central claims are reproducible from an accessible anonymous artifact, subject to separate artifact adjudication.
score_gaming_suggestions_to_reject: Do not relabel partial compiled-dispatch coverage as complete merely because Python callable identity and package-level compiled artifacts are recorded.
Do not describe the preproducer census or dual execution as independent validation of live-tensor binding; both retain the same binding trust assumption.
Do not convert constructed-fault success counts into unseen-defect recall, prevalence, or false-positive-rate estimates.
Do not add more closely aligned mutants as a substitute for an independently supplied or outcome-blind evaluation.
Do not imply production-scheduler robustness from deterministic single-stream interleaving, synchronized cancellation, or call-interval overlap without simultaneous kernel execution.
Do not promote the eight-item Store-F1 mean to a broad quality-preservation claim or hide its sample size behind aggregate memory percentages.
Do not count an artifact map, hashes, or one-command instructions as demonstrated clean-environment reproducibility without executing the submitted package.
Do not add further auxiliary tables or repeated caveats in place of narrowing and clarifying the central claim.
decision_rationale: All three reviewers independently assign 6 with marginally-above recommendations and agree on the paper's main value: a careful, executable-style, fail-closed ownership contract whose fixed-snapshot evidence is substantially stronger than output equality alone. They also converge on two core limitations: trusted live-tensor binding and incomplete compiled dispatch provenance. The remaining significance concerns differ in emphasis but can be resolved by one dependency-aware evaluation combining independent faults, a strong conventional baseline, and a representative scheduler. The manuscript is therefore above the rejection threshold on technical care, novelty of integration, and calibrated claims, but the current evidence ceiling is 6: it does not yet justify an 8 because one declared target is incomplete, the central physical-to-semantic binding remains trusted, and practical incremental value under realistic conditions is not established.
